paragraphs.text: Tsagan , Raider Warlord , is a legendary Saurid Berserker from Muraganda .

Tsagan is a character that was introduced in Alchemy: Aetherdrift . He is a Saurid from the Saurid Autocracy and likely worked alongside Tyrox to raid the Ghirapur Grand Prix when it came to Muraganda . He has prominent red scales along his head and arms intermixed with lighter green scales. Tsagan wields a large, golden cleaver-like blade as a weapon.
